turn.say: NakhlaID says NID-423 when I try to sign in. What should I do?

turns.reply:
The error code NID-423 means your NakhlaID account is locked due to 5 failed sign-in attempts within 15 minutes.

To unlock it, you have two options:

1. Wait 30 minutes and the lock will release automatically.
2. Unlock immediately by going to https://id.nakhla.example/unlock, entering your work email, and approving the NakhlaKey prompt or using a backup code.

If you forgot your password, you should reset it instead at https://id.nakhla.example/reset, which also unlocks the account.

If your account keeps locking, it may be caused by a device still trying an old password (e.g., mail app on your phone).

Not verified against the knowledge base (please do not treat as confirmed):
- Update or remove the old password on all devices to prevent repeated lockouts.
- For more details, see KB-006
